no_vcs.name: auryn-swift
no_vcs.summary: Swift language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-swift engine extracting classes/structs/enums/protocols/functions/methods/initializers/properties/params/cases, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS from superclass + protocol conformance, including via extensions), imports, and calls. A deep pass (SourceKit-LSP symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-sql
no_vcs.summary: Generic relational-database schema ingestor for Auryn: reflects any SQLAlchemy-supported engine (PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Oracle, ...) into Database/Schema/Table/Column/View/Sequence/Index/Constraint nodes plus foreign-key edges, via SQLAlchemy's dialect-agnostic Inspector. Dialect-specific DBAPI drivers are optional extras, auto-installed on demand.

no_vcs.name: auryn-rust
no_vcs.summary: Rust language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-rust engine extracting modules/structs/enums/traits/functions/methods/fields/variants/params/consts, the trait hierarchy (IMPLEMENTS/EXTENDS), and calls. A deep pass (rust-analyzer / rustc HIR symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-ruby
no_vcs.summary: Ruby language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-ruby engine extracting modules/classes/methods/functions/parameters/fields/constants, the class hierarchy (EXTENDS/INCLUDES), require graph (IMPORTS), and calls. A deep pass (a real Ruby loader / Sorbet / RBS symbol resolver for method dispatch and receiver types) is the planned second phase -- Ruby is dynamic, so the fast pass is name-based only.

no_vcs.name: auryn-python
no_vcs.summary: Python language plugin for Auryn: fast `ast` + deep Jedi (in-process) engines, plus the web-framework route enrichment.

no_vcs.name: auryn-php
no_vcs.summary: PHP language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-php engine extracting namespaces/classes/interfaces/traits/enums/functions/methods/properties/constants/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS/USES_TRAIT), and calls. A deep pass (full name-resolution: use-statement aliasing, autoloading, inherited-member calls) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-orm
no_vcs.summary: Language-agnostic ORM model<->database-table stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that joins a SQLAlchemy model class (in a code graph) to the physical Table/Column nodes a SQL ingestor produced (in a schema graph), by table/column name. Forms the code->database connection across two ingestors so a query can trace a function -> its ORM model -> the real table. Depends only on auryn-core.

no_vcs.name: auryn-oracle
no_vcs.summary: Oracle-stack plugins for Auryn: live-DB and file-based PL/SQL (vendored ANTLR grammar) and Redgate schema-catalog reconstruction (oraschema). (The generic relational-DB schema ingestor now lives in auryn-sql.)

no_vcs.name: auryn-kotlin
no_vcs.summary: Kotlin language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-kotlin engine extracting packages/classes/objects/interfaces/enums/methods/functions/fields/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS), and calls. A deep pass (Kotlin compiler / kotlin-language-server symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-julia
no_vcs.summary: Julia language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-julia engine extracting modules/structs/abstract+primitive types/generic functions/methods/fields/params, the subtype hierarchy (EXTENDS), multiple-dispatch (DISPATCHES_ON), and calls. A deep pass (Julia's own type inference for precise method resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-java
no_vcs.summary: Java language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-java engine extracting packages/classes/interfaces/enums/records/methods/fields/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS), and calls. A deep pass (Eclipse JDT / javac symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-http
no_vcs.summary: Language-agnostic HTTP call<->endpoint stitch for Auryn (ADR 0006): a post-ingestion hook that resolves route-keyed APIEndpoint placeholders (emitted by any caller language) to their handler Methods across the shared multi-repo graph, by route+verb. Order-independent, 1-to-many, provenance-scoped. Depends only on auryn-core.

no_vcs.name: auryn-grpc
no_vcs.summary: Language-agnostic gRPC/Protobuf contract stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that parses .proto service contracts and links a client's RPC call and a server's handler Method to the shared contract across languages (caller -CALLS_RPC-> RpcMethod <-IMPLEMENTS_RPC- handler). The RPC analog of the HTTP call<->endpoint seam; ties microservices written in different languages. Depends only on auryn-core.

no_vcs.name: auryn-go
no_vcs.summary: Go language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-go engine extracting packages/structs/interfaces/functions/methods/fields/params/consts, Go embedding (EMBEDS), and calls. IMPLEMENTS (structural interface satisfaction) and precise cross-file type resolution are the planned deep pass (a go/types or gopls-backed engine).

no_vcs.name: auryn-events
no_vcs.summary: Language-agnostic message/event-bus stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that ties a publisher to a subscriber through the topic/queue they share (publisher -PUBLISHES_TO-> Topic <-SUBSCRIBES_TO- subscriber) across Kafka/RabbitMQ/NATS/Redis-style brokers -- a decoupled connection that has no call edge in the graph. Depends only on auryn-core.
